# usage

Masthead usage bars, per-model weekly bar, per-session context gauge, usage poll and Keychain read.

- Spec: `docs/features/usage/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/usage/contract.md`

## Protocol

- `usage.refresh` — `POST /api/usage/refresh`
- `ws.usage` — The Usage object & `usage` message

## Facts

- `kb:fact/context-window-shape` — context_window carries context_window_size, used/remaining_percentage on a 0-100 scale, token totals and a current_usage object. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/context-window-shape.md`
- `kb:fact/oauth-token-in-keychain` — The subscription OAuth token lives in the macOS Keychain item "Claude Code-credentials" as claudeAiOauth.accessToken. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/oauth-token-in-keychain.md`
- `kb:fact/rate-limits-wire-shape` — rate_limits has five_hour and seven_day buckets (not weekly), each {used_percentage: float, resets_at: Unix epoch integer}. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/rate-limits-wire-shape.md`
- `kb:fact/refresh-interval-seconds` — statusLine.refreshInterval is in seconds, not milliseconds, and ticks while idle; without it an idle session posts nothing. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage, ingest) → `docs/facts/refresh-interval-seconds.md`
- `kb:fact/status-line-has-no-model-bucket` — The status line carries only five_hour and seven_day (plus spend_limit on gateway accounts); the per-model weekly window is never copied in. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/status-line-has-no-model-bucket.md`
- `kb:fact/status-line-keys` — Status-line top-level keys; permission_mode is never among them. Newer versions add scratchpad_dir and prompt_cache (superset). (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage, ingest) → `docs/facts/status-line-keys.md`
- `kb:fact/status-model-is-object` — The status line's model is an {id, display_name} object; only SessionStart.model is a bare string. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage, lifecycle) → `docs/facts/status-model-is-object.md`
- `kb:fact/status-posts-arrive-in-pairs` — Status-line posts are event-driven, ~50 ms after tool activity, and arrive in close pairs a median 435 ms apart. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/status-posts-arrive-in-pairs.md`
- `kb:fact/status-session-name-source` — Status-line session_name carries --name when given, otherwise a title Claude Code auto-generates; it is absent until one exists. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: rename, usage) → `docs/facts/status-session-name-source.md`
- `kb:fact/unknown-before-first-response` — Before a session's first API response rate_limits is absent and the context percentages are null: unknown, not 0%. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/unknown-before-first-response.md`
- `kb:fact/usage-api-oauth-shape` — GET https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage with the OAuth bearer and anthropic-beta: oauth-2025-04-20 returns five_hour, seven_day and limits[]. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.251..2.1.267; features: usage) → `docs/facts/usage-api-oauth-shape.md`
